dialogues.speaker: Shatha
dialogues.text: Me? Well, this might be the first time you've seen me on the night shift, so let me fill you in.

dialogues.speaker: Shatha
dialogues.text: Previously, we had a series of incidents in which Village Keepers were kidnapped, so the village head has added a few additional people to our patrols. Guess who's one of the lucky people?
